original: §1 evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto dharmaṃ deśayati sma |
analyzed: evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣu saṃghena sārdham ardha trayodaśabhiḥ bhikṣu śataiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtaḥ dharmam deśayati sma

original: §2 tena khalu punaḥ samayena nandiko nāmopāsakaḥ pañcopāsakaśataparivāro rājagṛhān nagarān niṣkramya yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ | upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ tripradakṣiṇīkṛtyaikānte nyaṣīdat | tāny api pañcopāsakaśatāni bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte niṣadanti sma |
analyzed: tena khalu punar samayena nandikaḥ nāma upāsakaḥ pañca upāsaka śata parivāraḥ rājagṛhāt nagarāt niṣkramya yena bhagavān tena upasaṃkrāntaḥ upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantam tri pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ekānte nyaṣīdat tāni api pañca upāsaka śatāni bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣadanti sma

original: ekānte niṣaṇṇaś ca nandikopāsako bhagavantam idam avocat |
analyzed: ekānte niṣaṇṇaḥ ca nandikā upāsakaḥ bhagavantam idam avocat

original: §3 yānīmāni bhagavatā jānatā paśyatā tathāgatenārthatā samyaksaṃbuddhenopāsakasya pañcaśikṣāpadāni prajñaptāni, tāni tasya vyatikrāmataḥ kiṃ vipākāni bhavantīti |
analyzed: yāni imāni bhagavatā jānatā paśyatā tathāgatena arthatā samyaksaṃbuddhena upāsakasya pañca śikṣā padāni prajñaptāni tāni tasya vyatikrāmataḥ kim vipākāni bhavanti iti

original: §4 evam ukte bhagavān nandikopāsakam idam avocat | sādhu sādhu nandika, udārā te buddhiḥ, bhadrikā te mīmāṃsā, kalyāṇaṃ te pratibhānam, yas tvaṃ tathāgatam etam arthaṃ paripraṣṭavyaṃ manyase | tena hi nandika daśādīnavaṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ deśayiṣyāmi | tac chṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasikuru, bhāṣiṣye 'haṃ te |
analyzed: evam ukte bhagavān nandika upāsakam idam avocat sādhu sādhu nandika udārā te buddhiḥ bhadrikā te mīmāṃsā kalyāṇam te pratibhānam yaḥ tvam tathāgatam etam artham paripraṣṭavyam manyase tena hi nandika daśādīnavam nāma dharmaparyāyam deśayiṣyāmi tat śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasikuru bhāṣiṣye ham te

original: sādhu bhagavann iti nandikopāsako bhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīt |
analyzed: sādhu bhagavan iti nandika upāsakaḥ bhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīt

original: §5 bhagavān etad avocat | daśeme nandikādīnavāḥ prāṇātipāte veditavyāḥ | katame daśa | tadyathā sādṛṣṭikaṃ vairaṃ prasravati, anyāsu jātiṣu ca vairānubandho bhavati | amanaāpadarśano bhavati | pāpakān svapnān paśyati | svayaṃ saṃtrāsam āpadyate | duḥkhaṃ ca svapiti, duḥkhaṃ ca pratibudhyate | pāpakaṃ ca vicintayati | saṃmūḍhaś ca kālaṃ karoti |
analyzed: bhagavān etat avocat daśa ime nandika ādīnavāḥ prāṇa atipāte veditavyāḥ katame daśa tat yathā sādṛṣṭikam vairam prasravati anyāsu jātiṣu ca vaira anubandhaḥ bhavati amanas apadarśanaḥ bhavati pāpakān svapnān paśyati svayam saṃtrāsam āpadyate duḥkham ca svapiti duḥkham ca pratibudhyate pāpakam ca vicintayati saṃmūḍhaḥ ca kālam karoti

original: alpāyuḥsaṃvartanīyaṃ ca karma karoty upacinoti | kāyasya bhedāt paraṃ maraṇād apāyadurgatinarakeṣūpapadyate | sacet punas tataś cyuta itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇāṃ sabhāgatāyai, sa yatra yatropapadyate, tatra tatrālpāyur bhavati bahuglāniś ca | ime nandika daśādīnavāḥ prāṇātipāte veditavyāḥ |
analyzed: alpa āyuḥ saṃvartanīyam ca karma karoti upacinoti kāyasya bhedāt param maraṇāt apāya durgati narakeṣu upapadyate saced punar tatas cyutaḥ itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇām sabhā gatāyai sa yatra yatra upapadyate tatra tatra alpa āyuḥ bhavati bahu glāniḥ ca ime nandika daśa ādīnavāḥ prāṇātipāte veditavyāḥ

original: §6 daśeme nandikādīnavā adattādāne veditavyāḥ | guruvairī ca bhavati | gurvāśaṅkī ca bhavati | akālacārī ca bhavati | pāpamitragṛhītaś ca bhavati | kalyāṇamitravivarjitaś ca bhavati | duḥśīlaś ca bhavati | rājopasargī ca bhavati, duṣṭopasargī ca bhavati, daṇḍopasargī ca bhavati | bhogavyasanasaṃvartanīyaṃ ca karma karoty upacinoti |
analyzed: daśa ime nandika ādīnavāḥ adatta ādāne veditavyāḥ guru vairī ca bhavati guru āśaṅkī ca bhavati akāla cārī ca bhavati pāpa mitra gṛhītaḥ ca bhavati kalyāṇa mitra vivarjitaḥ ca bhavati duḥśīlaḥ ca bhavati rāja upasargī ca bhavati duṣṭa upasargī ca bhavati daṇḍa upasargī ca bhavati bhoga vyasana saṃvartanīyam ca karma karoti upacinoti

original: kāyasya bhedāt paraṃ maraṇād apāyadurgativinipātanarakeṣūpapadyate | sacet punas tataś cyuta itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇāṃ sabhāgatāyai, sa yatra yatropapadyate, tatra tatra daridro bhavati, alpabhogaś ca | ye ca tasya bhogā bhavanty utthānavīryāvigatā jaṅghābāhubalopārjitāḥ svedamalāvakṣiptās te pañcabhir upakleśair upakliṣṭā bhavanti |
analyzed: kāyasya bhedāt param maraṇāt apāya durgati vinipāta narakeṣu upapadyate saced punar tatas cyutaḥ itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇām sabhāgatāyai sa yatra yatra upapadyate tatra tatra daridraḥ bhavati alpa bhogaḥ ca ye ca tasya bhogāḥ bhavanti utthāna vīrya avigatāḥ jaṅghā bāhu bala upārjitāḥ sveda mala avakṣiptāḥ te pañcabhiḥ upakleśaiḥ upakliṣṭāḥ bhavanti

original: katamaiḥ pañcabhiḥ | rājato vā, caurato vā, agnito vā, udakato vā, apriyadāyādebhyo vā nihitāś cāsya vinaśyanti | ime nandika daśādīnavā adattādāne veditavyāḥ |
analyzed: katamaiḥ pañcabhiḥ rājataḥ vā caurataḥ vā agnitaḥ vā udakataḥ vā apriya dāyādebhyaḥ vā nihitāḥ ca asya vinaśyanti ime nandika daśa ādīnavāḥ adatta ādāne veditavyāḥ

original: §7 daśeme nandikādīnavāḥ kāmamithyācāre veditavyāḥ | katame daśa | yeṣāṃ dārān abhimardayati taiś cāsya saha vairaṃ bhavati | bhāryayā saha vivādo bhavati | akuśalāś cāsya dharmā vivardhayanti, kuśalāś cāsya dharmāḥ parihīyante | ātmā cāsyāgupto bhavaty arakṣitaḥ, jīvitaṃ cāsyāguptaṃ bhavaty arakṣitam | putradāraṃ cāsyāguptaṃ bhavaty arakṣitam |
analyzed: daśa ime nandika ādīnavāḥ kāma mithyā ācāre veditavyāḥ katame daśa yeṣām dārān abhimardayati taiḥ ca asya saha vairam bhavati bhāryayā saha vivādaḥ bhavati akuśalāḥ ca asya dharmāḥ vivardhayanti kuśalāḥ ca asya dharmāḥ parihīyante ātmā ca asya a guptaḥ bhavati a rakṣitaḥ jīvitam ca asya a guptam bhavati a rakṣitam putra dāram ca asya a guptam bhavati a rakṣitam

original: dhanaṃ cāsyāguptaṃ bhavaty arakṣitam, gṛhaṃ cāsyāguptaṃ bhavaty arakṣitam | mitrāmātyajñātisālohitāś cāsya viśvāsaṃ na gacchanti | sasāpatnyasaṃvartanīyaṃ ca karma karoty upacinoti | kāyasya bhedāt paraṃ maraṇād apāyadurgativinipātanarakeṣūpapadyate |
analyzed: dhanam ca asya a guptam bhavati a rakṣitam gṛham ca asya a guptam bhavati a rakṣitam mitra amātya jñāti sālohitāḥ ca asya viśvāsam na gacchanti sa sāpatnya saṃvartanīyam ca karma karoti upacinoti kāyasya bhedāt param maraṇāt apāya durgati vinipāta narakeṣu upapadyate

original: sacet punas tataś cyuta itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇāṃ sabhāgatāyai, sa yadi strī bhavati, sasāpatnyaṃ bhartāraṃ pratilabhate, atha puruṣo bhavati, putradāram asyārakṣitaṃ bhavati | ime nandika daśādīnavāḥ kāmamithyācāre veditavyāḥ |
analyzed: saced punar tatas cyutaḥ itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇām sabhā gatāyai sa yadi strī bhavati sa sāpatnyam bhartāram pratilabhate atha puruṣaḥ bhavati putra dāram asya arakṣitam bhavati ime nandika daśa ādīnavāḥ kāma mithyā ācāre veditavyāḥ

original: §8 daśeme nandikādīnavā mṛṣāvāde veditavyāḥ | katame daśa | pūtikaṃ cāsya mukhaṃ bhavati | devatāś cāsya kāyād apakrāmanty amanuṣyāś cāsyāvatāraṃ labhante | satyam api bhāṣyamāṇasyāśraddheyaṃ vacanaṃ bhavati | utpanneṣu kāryeṣu nainaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ paripraṣṭavyaṃ manyante | abhūtaś cāsyāvarṇo vaistāriko bhavati | apratyutthānārhaś ca bhavati |
analyzed: daśa ime nandika ādīnavāḥ mṛṣāvāde veditavyāḥ katame daśa pūtikam ca asya mukham bhavati devatāḥ ca asya kāyāt apakrāmanti amanuṣyāḥ ca asya avatāram labhante satyam api bhāṣyamāṇasya aśraddheyam vacanam bhavati utpanneṣu kāryeṣu na enam vidvāṃsaḥ paripraṣṭavyam manyante abhūtaḥ ca asya avarṇaḥ vaistārikaḥ bhavati a pratyutthāna arhaḥ ca bhavati

original: bahuduḥkhadaurmanasyo bhavati | abhyākhyānabahulasaṃvartanīyaṃ ca karma karoty upacinoti | kāyasya bhedāt paraṃ maraṇād apāyadurgativinipātanarakeṣūpapadyate | sacet punas tataś cyuta itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇāṃ sabhāgatāyai, sa yatra yatropapadyate, tatra tatrābhyākhyānabahulo bhavati | ime nandika daśādīnavā mṛṣāvāde veditavyāḥ |
analyzed: bahu duḥkha daurmanasyaḥ bhavati abhyākhyāna bahula saṃvartanīyam ca karma karoti upacinoti kāyasya bhedāt param maraṇāt apāya durgati vinipāta narakeṣu upapadyate saced punar tatas cyutaḥ itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇām sabhā gatāyai sa yatra yatra upapadyate tatra tatra abhyākhyāna bahulaḥ bhavati ime nandika daśa ādīnavāḥ mṛṣāvāde veditavyāḥ

original: §9 pañcatriṃśad ime nandikādīnavāḥ surāmaireyamadyapramādasthāne veditavyāḥ | katame pañcatriṃśat | sāṃdṛṣṭikaṃ kośakṣayaḥ | rogānām āyatanam | kalahavigrahavivardhanam | kaupīnasaṃdarśanam | akīrtisaṃjananam | prajñādaurbalyakaraṇam | anadhigatāś ca bhogā nādhigacchanti, adhigatāś ca bhogāḥ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchanti | guhyaṃ ca vivṛṇoti |
analyzed: pañcatriṃśat ime nandikā ādīnavāḥ surā maireya madya pramāda sthāne veditavyāḥ katame pañcatriṃśat sāṃdṛṣṭikam kośa kṣayaḥ rogānām āyatanam kalaha vigraha vivardhanam kaupīna saṃdarśanam akīrti saṃjananam prajñā daurbalya karaṇam anadhigatāḥ ca bhogāḥ na adhigacchanti adhigatāḥ ca bhogāḥ parikṣayam paryādānam gacchanti guhyam ca vivṛṇoti

original: karmāntāś cāsya parihīyante | daurbalyakaraṇaṃ ca bhavati | amātṛjñaś ca bhavati | apitṛjñaś ca bhavati | aśrāmaṇyaś ca bhavati | abrāhmaṇyaś ca bhavati | na kulajyeṣṭhāpacāyako bhavati | buddhe 'gauravo bhavati | dharme 'gauravo bhavati | saṃghe 'gauravo bhavati | śikṣāsamādāne cāgauravo bhavati | indriyeṣv aguptadvāro bhavati |
analyzed: karmāntāḥ ca asya parihīyante daurbalya karaṇam ca bhavati a mātṛ jñaḥ ca bhavati a pitṛ jñaḥ ca bhavati a śrāmaṇyaḥ ca bhavati a brāhmaṇyaḥ ca bhavati na kula jyeṣṭha apacāyakaḥ bhavati buddhe gauravaḥ bhavati dharme gauravaḥ bhavati saṃghe gauravaḥ bhavati śikṣā samādāne ca a gauravaḥ bhavati indriyeṣu a gupta dvāraḥ bhavati

original: strīṣu cātyarthaṃ pramādam āpadyate | mitrāmātyajñātisālohitānāṃ cāgrāhyo bhavati | bahulāmanaāpaś ca bhavati | bahujanapratikūlaś ca bhavati | adharmacārī bhavati | akarmapratigrāhakaś ca bhavati | saddharmaparivarjitaś ca bhavati | apatrāpyaparivarjitaś ca bhavati | na cainaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ pratyayeṣu sthāneṣu paripraṣṭavyaṃ manyante |
analyzed: strīṣu ca atyartham pramādam āpadyate mitra amātya jñāti sālohitānām ca agrāhyaḥ bhavati bahula amanaāpaḥ ca bhavati bahu jana pratikūlaḥ ca bhavati adharma cārī bhavati a karma pratigrāhakaḥ ca bhavati saddharma parivarjitaḥ ca bhavati apatrāpya parivarjitaḥ ca bhavati na ca enam vidvāṃsaḥ pratyayeṣu sthāneṣu paripraṣṭavyam manyante

original: pramādaṃ ca kṛtvopekṣako bhavati | tathāgatavacane na saṃtiṣṭhati | dūrībhavati nirvāṇāt | unmattasaṃvartanīyaṃ ca karma karoty upacinoti | kāyasya bhedāt paraṃ maraṇād apāyadurgativinipātanarakeṣūpapadyate | sacet punas tataś cyuta itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇāṃ sabhāgatāyai, sa yatra yatropapadyate, tatra tatra unmatto bhavati mūḍhasmṛtiḥ |
analyzed: pramādam ca kṛtvā upekṣakaḥ bhavati tathāgata vacane na saṃtiṣṭhati dūrībhavati nirvāṇāt unmatta saṃvartanīyam ca karma karoti upacinoti kāyasya bhedāt param maraṇāt apāya durgati vinipāta narakeṣu upapadyate saced punar tatas cyutaḥ itthatvam āgacchati manuṣyāṇām sabhāgatāyai sa yatra yatra upapadyate tatra tatra unmattaḥ bhavati mūḍha smṛtiḥ
